articles.title: The Magic Staple Trick That Could Build the Future
articles.summary: A bundle of office staples can act like a solid block—then fall apart in seconds with the right shake. Scientists think staple-shaped particles could lead to strong, reusable materials for buildings and robots.

articles.title: A Giant Ocean Bump Is Sneaking Toward South America—And It Could Shake Up the Weather
articles.summary: NASA's satellite spotted a huge swell of warm water—over 5.9 inches higher than normal—moving toward Peru. This "Kelvin wave" could mean El Niño is coming, bringing wild weather like floods and droughts around the world.

articles.title: Honey Bees Have Their Own Secret Flight Maps—And They're Super Accurate
articles.summary: Scientists used a drone to track bees and found each one follows its own exact flight path, like a personal highway in the sky. They use trees and hedges as signposts, and can repeat their route within a few centimeters.
